name: Sakura Hitohira
source:
Reiko wakes up with all her memories lost. With the help of servant boy she tries to reveal identity of the murder incident and also to return her memories.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
丽子醒来时失去了所有记忆。在仆人少年的帮助下，她试图揭开谋杀事件的真相，同时找回自己的记忆。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
